text:
sam: Nightly CI red on hetero-node-42, failing warmup with OOM + kernel error. Seen on canary image (gcr.io/redwood/cuda:12.2-canary). Full job: https://ci.redwood.dev/tx/9876/artifacts :grimacing:

ci-bot: job 9876 failed on shard 3/8. Exit code 137, kernel log attached: s3://redwood-ci/9876/shard3/kernel.log

mira: Ugh. Error looks like `invalid device function` then `Xid 31`. Can you paste the kernel.log tail?

sam: here are the last lines:
```
[ 1123.452] Xid (31) : PID 5627: RTX kernel timeout
[ 1123.453] NVRM: GPU 3: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1123.454] invalid device function
```

kai: likely driver/runtime mismatch with the canary CUDA. Which driver version on the node? `nvidia-smi -q` from the job?

dylan: grabbed node info from artifacts: /var/log/node-info.txt -> driver 515.105, libcudart 12.2.0. Looks skewed. Also saw repeated allocations before OOM: `malloc failed` in quant attention kernel.

mira: hmm that's classic: userland built against 12.2 but host driver too old -> JIT PTX fallback might produce invalid device function.

jen: can we rerun on a node with driver 535? I can queue a targeted rerun on pool-rtx-535. Want me to try? :hand:

sam: yes pls queue. Also cc @eng-infra — if skew is happening in the canary image rollout we should stop it.

oncall: pinged infra, marking incident: INC-2026-394. Putting temporary hold on canary until triage complete.

ci-bot: queued rerun 9876.r1 on pool-rtx-535, ETA ~12m. Artifacts will land at https://ci.redwood.dev/tx/9876.r1

kai: if rerun passes, we should do a quick bisect on recent driver pin changes in images (sha: a1b2c3). I can start a binary search across last 10 image builds.

mira: also add a smoke that checks `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader` and fails if <525 for CUDA12 images. Prevents future mismatch.

sam: agreed. jen — after rerun, can you snapshot node env and attach `ldd` of the failing lib?

jen: will do. queued a node snapshot as artifact 9876.r1.node-snapshot.tar.gz

ci-bot: rerun 9876.r1 completed: FAILED again, but different: now OOM at warmup step 2 (shard 5), kernel log shows `out of memory` then `GPU reset`.

sam: different shard, same suite. Could be memory regression or multi-tenant interference. Any recent change to kvcache or batch sizing?

kai: there was a tiny kvcache tweak in PR #1427 that touched allocation accounting. rolling back locally reproduces lower mem use for the warmup test. I'll open a revert PR if artifacts confirm.

mira: can we get a flamegraph or nvprof snapshot from failing job? The artifacts contain `cuda-memtrace.log`. dylan, can you grep for allocation spikes?

dylan: found spike at step 18: alloc +1.2GB from attention kernel then free delayed ~3s. Looks like a race in cache eviction.

sam: ok plan: (1) kai to open revert PR for kvcache allocation accounting (2) infra to continue canary hold until driver rollout is validated (3) add smoke driver check for images (mira) (4) run targeted memregress CI with revert candidate pinned (jen + kai).

jen: noted, I'll run the memregress on pool-rtx-535 and pool-a100 for coverage.

oncall: updating INC-2026-394 with action items and owners.

mira: thanks all. I’ll follow up with a quick PR for the image smoke and post here when merged. :thumbsup:
